notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1930. Curated: land, buildings and plans.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: the Sharp Park golf course by Alister Mackenzie and its starter's house by Willis Polk & Co. (outside the city), the Harding Park dining pavilion (John Bjorkman), Great Highway comfort stations opposite Judah and Taraval (street hub only), the Amundsen bautastone beside the Gjoa, an Aquatic Park recreation pier.

findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners received the Supervisors' resolution placing under its charge, for park purposes, the Mount Davidson land Aug. J. Lang, Jr. had deeded to the city in two deeds, including about 7.86 acres adjoining Juanita Way.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, January 9, 1930

findings.address_as_written: Bids - repairs to the Palace of Fine Arts
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners awarded Monson Bros., the low bidder at $26,480, the contract for repairs to the Palace of Fine Arts, from plans by the engineer Henry D. Dewell.

findings.address_as_written: Plans, new wing, California Academy of Sciences
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners approved the plans, presented by Academy director Barton W. Evermann and architect Lewis P. Hobart, for a new wing of the California Academy of Sciences, and let the Academy proceed with its construction.
